# Agni by Ravan.ai - Documentation for LLMs

> Agni is the world's most natural voice AI platform. Real emotion. Real turn-taking. Real conversation.

## About
- Product: Agni Voice AI Platform
- Company: Ravan.ai
- Website: https://ravan.ai
- API Base URL: https://api.ravan.ai
- Documentation: https://agni-docs-frontend.vercel.app

## What Agni Does
Agni provides real-time voice AI agents that can handle phone calls with human-like emotion, turn-taking, and conversation flow. Used by 2,000+ businesses for customer support, appointment booking, outbound sales, lead qualification, and after-hours answering.

## Key Features
- Sub-300ms latency voice conversations
- Model-agnostic runtime (routes across LLM providers)
- 50+ language support
- Telephony integration (Twilio, SIP)
- Calendar integrations (GoHighLevel, Cal.com)
- Custom tools and function calling
- Post-call analysis and sentiment tracking
- RAG Knowledge Base for agent context
- Webhook notifications
- $0.07/minute flat pricing

## API Authentication
All API requests require an X-Api-Key header. Keys are managed at https://ravan.ai under Settings > API Keys.

## Documentation Structure
- /guides/authentication - Account setup and API key generation
- /guides/agents - Creating and configuring voice AI agents
- /guides/tools - Adding functions (end call, call transfer)
- /guides/calls - Call session monitoring and transcripts
- /guides/appointments - Calendar booking integration
- /guides/dashboard - Workspace metrics and analytics
- /guides/analytics - Performance KPIs and reporting
- /guides/inbound-calls - Inbound call routing and dispatch
- /guides/phone-numbers - Telephony setup (BYOT or managed)
- /guides/billing - Pricing, credits, and cost optimization
- /guides/settings - Organization, security, and integrations
- /api-reference/introduction - REST API overview
- /api-reference/agents/* - Agent CRUD endpoints
- /api-reference/tools/* - Tool CRUD endpoints
- /api-reference/contacts/* - Contact management endpoints
- /api-reference/telephony/* - Phone number management
- /api-reference/rag/* - Knowledge base endpoints
- /api-reference/webhooks/* - Webhook configuration
- /api-reference/calcom/* - Cal.com integration
- /api-reference/ghl/* - GoHighLevel integration
- /api-reference/health/* - Health check endpoints
